description: ISL hand sign alphabet labels — index maps to class label
input_description: 21 MediaPipe hand landmarks × 3 coordinates (x, y, z), flattened in landmark order 0-20, NO additional normalization
preprocessing: raw MediaPipe normalized coordinates, flattened: [lm0.x, lm0.y, lm0.z, lm1.x, ..., lm20.z]
notes: The reference repository does NOT include a downloadable .h5 model file. Place your trained model at backend/app/models/isl_model.keras
